definition: Spark NLP is an open-source text processing library for advanced natural language processing for the Python, Java and Scala programming languages.
details: The library is built on top of Apache Spark and its Spark ML library. Its purpose is to provide an API for natural language processing pipelines that implement recent academic research results as production-grade, scalable, and trainable software. The library offers pre-trained neural network models, pipelines, and embeddings, as well as support for training custom models.

explainer.lead: Spark NLP is an open-source library for production-grade natural language processing built on Apache Spark. It matters because it turns recent NLP research into scalable, trainable pipelines that run across Python, Java and Scala.

tiers.eli5: Think of a factory line for text: raw sentences go in one end, and cleaned-up, analysed text comes out the other, with each station doing one job.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers assemble pipelines from pre-trained neural models, pipelines and embeddings, and can train custom models on top of Spark ML. A common pitfall is treating Spark's distributed overhead as free—small datasets often run faster on a single machine.
tiers.paperLevel: It is defined as an open-source text processing library providing an API for NLP pipelines built atop Apache Spark and Spark ML; its limits follow from Spark's distributed execution model.

explainer.example: A team loads a pre-trained pipeline in Python to tokenise, embed and classify millions of support tickets in parallel across a Spark cluster.
